note: Lean's generic lemma takes the integrability and L2 moment hypotheses (integral_norm_sq_flineG/DG) in place of Lemma hausierer with its norm conditions.

snippet.text:
/-- **`η₊²`**: `|Σ Λ(n) η₊²(n/x) − x ∫η₊²| ≤ G₀ Z₃ + √x E₁ + x E₂ + x^{−1/2} V/2π` under RH up to `500`. -/
theorem norm_SsumG_phi1_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x)
    (hRH : ∀ ρ : ℂ, riemannZeta ρ = 0 → 0 < ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 → |ρ.im| ≤ 500 → ρ.re = 1 / 2) :
    ‖SsumG (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) phi1 x - mellin phi1 1 * x‖ ≤
      (Cg * (2 * aH)) ^ 2 * 8 * Z3g BPz2 0 + √x * E1g BPz2 500 (2 * π * 65.5) (2 * π * 147.7) +
      x * E2g BPz2 10 500 ((Cg * (2 * aH)) ^ 2 * 8 * Real.exp (-60)) 0 (Real.exp (-2.64)) 0 +
      x ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) * VgL 3 ((Cg * (2 * aH)) ^ 2 * 8 * Real.exp 1) (1 / 400) / (2 * π) := by
  have hp := plancherelData_phi1
  refine norm_SsumG_zeta_le_gen goodSmoothing_phi1 hx (by norm_num) hRH phi1_zero (mellin_half_eq phi1)
    (hasDerivAt_flineG hp) (continuous_flineDG hp) (by positivity) (by positivity)
    (integrable_norm_sq_flineG hp) (integrable_norm_sq_flineDG hp) ?_ ?_ (by positivity) le_rfl
    (Real.exp_pos _).le rhoP_lt_one le_rfl zero_lt_one phi1_tail (by norm_num) (by positivity) phi1_vert
  · rw [integral_norm_sq_flineG hp]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left integral_phi1_sq_le (by positivity)
  · rw [integral_norm_sq_flineDG hp]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left integral_log_sq_phi1_sq_le (by positivity)

proof_context.conclusion: Explicit-formula bound for $\sum\Lambda(n)\eta_+^2(n/x)-x\int\eta_+^2$ under RH to 500, via the generic bound `norm_SsumG_zeta_le_gen`, with terms Z3g (residue/zero), E1g, E2g, and the x^{-1/2} VgL term.

/-- **`η₊² log`**: the same for `Σ Λ(n) η₊²(n/x) log(n/x) − x ∫η₊² log`. -/
theorem norm_SsumG_phi2_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x)
    (hRH : ∀ ρ : ℂ, riemannZeta ρ = 0 → 0 < ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 → |ρ.im| ≤ 500 → ρ.re = 1 / 2) :
    ‖SsumG (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) phi2 x - mellin phi2 1 * x‖ ≤
      2 * ((Cg * (2 * aH)) ^ 2 * 8) * Z3g BPz2 0 + √x * E1g BPz2 500 (2 * π * 147.7) (2 * π * 338.2) +
      x * E2g BPz2 10 500 (2 * (Cg * (2 * aH)) ^ 2 * 8 * Real.exp (0.3 - 60)) 0 (Real.exp (-2.64)) 0 +
      x ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) * VgL 3 (2 * ((Cg * (2 * aH)) ^ 2 * 8 * Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (1 / 800)))
        (1 / 400) / (2 * π) := by
  have hp := plancherelData_phi2
  refine norm_SsumG_zeta_le_gen goodSmoothing_phi2 hx (by norm_num) hRH phi2_zero (mellin_half_eq phi2)
    (hasDerivAt_flineG hp) (continuous_flineDG hp) (by positivity) (by positivity)
    (integrable_norm_sq_flineG hp) (integrable_norm_sq_flineDG hp) ?_ ?_ (by positivity) le_rfl
    (Real.exp_pos _).le rhoP_lt_one le_rfl zero_lt_one phi2_tail (by norm_num) (by positivity) phi2_vert
  · rw [integral_norm_sq_flineG hp]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left integral_phi2_sq_le (by positivity)
  · rw [integral_norm_sq_flineDG hp]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left integral_log_sq_phi2_sq_le (by positivity)

/-- **Explicit-formula bound, general smoothing, `ζ`.** -/
theorem norm_SsumG_zeta_le_gen {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {K c : ℝ} (hφ : GoodSmoothing φ K c) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x)
    {T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 50 ≤ T0)
    (hRH : ∀ ρ : ℂ, riemannZeta ρ = 0 → 0 < ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 → |ρ.im| ≤ T0 → ρ.re = 1 / 2)
    {G0 : ℝ} (hM0 : ‖mellin φ 0‖ ≤ G0)
    {F F' : ℝ → ℂ} (hMF : ∀ t : ℝ, mellin φ (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I) = F t)
    (hF : ∀ t, HasDerivAt F (F' t) t) (hF' : Continuous F')
    {Q1 Q2 : ℝ} (hQ1 : 0 < Q1) (hQ2 : 0 < Q2)
    (hF2 : Integrable fun t => ‖F t‖ ^ 2) (hF2' : Integrable fun t => ‖F' t‖ ^ 2)
    (hFQ : ∫ t, ‖F t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Q1) (hFQ' : ∫ t, ‖F' t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Q2)
    {EB' EA' ρB ρA : ℝ} (hEB : 0 ≤ EB') (hEA : 0 ≤ EA') (hρB0 : 0 ≤ ρB) (hρB1 : ρB < 1)
    (hρA0 : 0 ≤ ρA) (hρA1 : ρA < 1)
    (htail : ∀ s : ℂ, 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → T0 < |s.im| →
      ‖mellin φ s‖ ≤ EB' * ρB ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ + EA' * ρA ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊)
    {Kv θv : ℝ} (hθv : 0 < θv) (hKv : 0 ≤ Kv)
    (hv : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖mellin φ (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I)‖ ≤ Kv * Real.exp (-(θv * |y|))) :
    ‖SsumG (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) φ x - mellin φ 1 * x‖ ≤ G0 * Z3g BPz2 0 +
      √x * E1g BPz2 T0 Q1 Q2 + x * E2g BPz2 10 T0 EB' EA' ρB ρA +
        x ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) * VgL 3 Kv θv / (2 * π) := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  obtain ⟨Tk, -, hlim⟩ := explicit_formula_zeta hφ hx0
  set I0 := ∫ y : ℝ, hZeta φ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I) with hI0
  have hG : ∀ ρ : ℂ, zetaF ρ = 0 → 0 < ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 → |ρ.im| ≤ T0 → ρ.re = 1 / 2 := by
    intro ρ h0 h1 h2 h3
    have hρ1 : ρ ≠ 1 := by intro h; rw [h] at h2; simp at h2
    have : riemannZeta ρ = 0 := by
      rw [zetaF_of_ne hρ1] at h0
      rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h0 with h | h
      · exact absurd (sub_eq_zero.1 h) hρ1
      · exact h
    exact hRH ρ this h1 h2 h3
  have hb : ∀ T : ℝ, ‖∑ u ∈ zerosRectD zetaF T, (multRectD zetaF T u : ℂ) * (mellin φ u * (x : ℂ) ^ u)‖ ≤
      G0 * Z3g BPz2 0 + √x * E1g BPz2 T0 Q1 Q2 + x * E2g BPz2 10 T0 EB' EA' ρB ρA := fun T =>
    zero_sum_boundG polyDatum_zeta2 (fun T u hu => zerosRectD_zetaF_cases hu) hT0 hG (mellin φ) hM0
      hMF hF hF' hQ1 hQ2 hF2 hF2' hFQ hFQ' hEB hEA hρB0 hρB1 hρA0 hρA1 htail hx T
  have h1 : ‖mellin φ 1 * x - SsumG (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) φ x - (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * I0‖ ≤
      G0 * Z3g BPz2 0 + √x * E1g BPz2 T0 Q1 Q2 + x * E2g BPz2 10 T0 EB' EA' ρB ρA :=
    le_of_tendsto' ((continuous_norm.tendsto _).comp hlim) fun k => hb (Tk k)
  have h2 : ‖(1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * I0‖ ≤ x ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) * VgL 3 Kv θv / (2 * π) := by
    rw [norm_mul]
    have : ‖(1 / (2 * π) : ℂ)‖ = 1 / (2 * π) := by
      rw [norm_div, norm_one, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
    rw [this, div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (norm_integral_hZeta_le_gen hθv hKv hv hx0) (by positivity)
  have e : SsumG (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) φ x - mellin φ 1 * x =
      -((mellin φ 1 * x - SsumG (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) φ x - (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * I0) +
        (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * I0) := by ring
  rw [e, norm_neg]
  exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)

proof_context.conclusion: Generic explicit-formula bound (the analogue of Lemma agamon plus hausierer) applied to each of phi1, phi2.

proof.summary: The generic explicit-formula bound `norm_SsumG_zeta_le_gen` is applied to each of φ₁ and φ₂ once the norms are known to be finite.
